uses: synthetic development results (unchanged by calibration data — public cards only)
existing replay/invariant/symmetry/probability/competition certifications, which consume no calibration profile
data.metrics: the frozen V6 metric set and practical margins (historical-v6-practical-margins), applied per trait with the dual gate
data.seeds: tier-0 diagnostic block of the HISTORICAL_V6_FORMAL domain (v6SurfaceSeed tier 0) — never the formal decision tiers

classificationRules.DATA_PIPELINE_RESOLVED: hard fail under formal inputs; passes or drops inside margin with complete records, before enrichment mattered
classificationRules.ROLE_BACKFILL_RESOLVED: resolves only once role enrichment is present
classificationRules.DEFENSIVE_EVIDENCE_RESOLVED: resolves only once defensive-evidence enrichment is present
classificationRules.DATA_LIMITATION: input the sources cannot provide (e.g. unrecorded splits); no engine change can honestly compensate
classificationRules.REFERENCE_LIMITATION: the reference instrument cannot carry the claim
classificationRules.TRAIT_MAPPING_LIMITATION: the claim/metric mapping is the defect
classificationRules.REAL_ENGINE_FAILURE: persists with complete inputs AND reproduces on non-V6 development controls

data.passFailRules: a diagnostic classification never changes the formal V6 verdict; REAL_ENGINE_FAILURE routes to the persistent-failure workstream
